item.title: TwitchAdBlock v31.7
item.description:
Twitch 31.7 | TwitchAdBlock 0.1.15
**TwitchMods v0.1.15**, for Twitch iOS **31.7**
### New: see what moderators delete Turn on **Keep Deleted Messages** in Settings → Emotes. When a moderator deletes a message, or times out or bans someone, their messages **stay in chat** instead of disappearing, and a short note like **"🛡 ronni was timed out for 10m"** shows up so you know what happened. - Want the notes to stand out? Turn on **Highlight Notes**, right under it, to give them a highlighted background. - Both are off by default. It only works for things that happen while you're in chat.
### New: hide the "From channels you follow" bar Turn on **Hide "From Channels You Follow"** in Settings → Home to remove the row of clips and recaps above the live channels on the Live page.
### Fixed - The **"Go Ad-Free"** button on the Following tab is hidden again. Twitch 31.7 rebuilt that tab, so the old way of hiding it stopped working.
Everything from v0.1.14 is still included: Twitch 31.7 support, ad-blocking, 7TV / BTTV / FFZ emotes (send them with the 7TV bar or by holding the emote button), Keep Live Feed Playing, Hide Stories and your default launch screen.
### Downloads - **`tv.twitch-31.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.15.ipa`**: the full app. - **`tv.twitch-31.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.15-noplugins.ipa`**: app extensions removed, so a free Apple ID only uses 1 App ID slot when sideloading.
Using the AltStore / SideStore / Feather source? You'll get this update automatically: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gunnerkidBT/TwitchAdBlock/master/apps.json ```
Full plain-language changelog: [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/gunnerkidBT/TwitchAdBlock/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)

item.title: NeoFreeBird v7.2.0
item.description:
Twitter 7.2.0 | NeoFreeBird-sideloaded-Twitter_7.2.0_12.33
# Version 7.2.0
## New Features - Added an option to choose the default reply sort - Updated X to 12.33 - Added an option to hide retweets and quotes from the “For You” page - Added option to convert [t.co](http://t.co/) links and remove link tracking by @PEEKPerformer in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/135 - Updated NFB settings to use the new settings design. You now hold the bird (or X) on the For You page to access NFB settings - Brought back the Tweet source labels! - Removed the “Money” tab - Enabling the option to hide views now also hides it in the tweet footer.
## Fixes - Fixed more webview issues - NeoFreeBird now more reliably filters out video ads - Fixed hiding both the “Follow” and “Message” button on tweets by @sekiranunn in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/140 - Tweaked the wording of the “Reply in web view” option to highlight it’s a fallback by @PEEKPerformer in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/138 - Added localization support for the “Show quote numbers option” - Fixed the app crashing when adding more than 1 account
## Localizations * Update Japanese localization for in-app browser text by @so-5699 in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/130 * Update French localization by @jleroy in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/132 * Update Japanese localization for reply sorting options by @so-5699 in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/136 * Update Arabic localization by @ipapplus in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/139 * Update Turkish localization by @Huseyin-Korkmaz in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/142
## New Contributors * @so-5699 made their first contribution in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/130 * @jleroy made their first contribution in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/132 * @PEEKPerformer made their first contribution in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/135 * @ipapplus made their first contribution in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/139 * @Huseyin-Korkmaz made their first contribution in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/142 * @sekiranunn made their first contribution in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/140
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/compare/v7.1.1...v7.2.0

item.description:

## Tweaks - Rewrote MobileGestalt View + Added a ton of tweaks! (thanks @jurre111) - Rewrote Liquid Glass View with nice previewer. - Fixed Passcode + Add repo viewer (thanks @neonmodder123) - Add SpringBoard Customizer (thanks @leminlimez and Cowabunga, as well as @jurre111 for fixing the view) - Add SystemColor patcher.
